title: HACP Decision Token
description: Cryptographically signed token authorizing a specific proposed action.

hacp_version.description: HACP protocol version this token conforms to.

token_id.description: Unique token identifier (jti). Used for revocation.

action_hash.description: SHA-256 (lowercase hex) of the canonicalized ProposedAction.

policy_digest.description: SHA-256 (lowercase hex) of the policy definition in effect at decision time.

principal.description: Identifier of the decision subject (human or system authority).

signer_key_id.description: Key identifier (kid) of the Ed25519 signing key.

decision.description: Authorization outcome for the bound action.

constraints.description: Optional execution constraints (e.g., tool binding, retry limits).

signature.description: Ed25519 signature (base64url, no padding) over the canonicalized token payload excluding this field.
